info.title: Krova Cloud API
info.description: Programmatic access to Krova Cloud. Authenticate with the X-API-KEY header. Keys are scoped per Space and inherit the permissions of the membership that created them. Mutating POST / DELETE endpoints are rate-limited to 10 requests per 60 seconds per client IP.

responseHeaderOverrides.description: Header rewrites: `set` adds/overwrites, `remove` deletes. Null clears all.

requestHeaderOverrides.description: Header rewrites: `set` adds/overwrites, `remove` deletes. Null clears all.

items.description: A Krova webhook event name (see the webhooks docs for the full list).

Forbidden.description: Authenticated but lacks the required permission

get.summary: Per-resource hourly rates and volume pricing tiers

post.description: Public, unauthenticated. Mints a device code (returned once) and a short human user code, and returns the verification URIs the user opens in a browser to approve. The CLI then polls /auth/cli/poll. Rate-limited per client IP.

deviceCode.description: High-entropy code the CLI keeps secret and presents on each poll. Only its hash is stored server-side.

userCode.description: Short human-readable code (KROVA-XXXX-XXXX) the user confirms in the browser.

verificationUri.description: Browser URL where the user approves.

verificationUriComplete.description: verificationUri with the user code pre-filled.

expiresIn.description: Seconds until the device code expires (~600).

503.description: Could not allocate a login code; retry

post.description: Public, unauthenticated. The CLI submits its deviceCode until the user approves or denies. On approval a real API key is minted ONCE, scoped to the approved Space and the approving user's membership, and returned a single time. Rate-limited per client IP.

apiKey.description: The full API key. Shown once and never returned again — store it securely.

spaceId.description: The Space the key is scoped to.

403.description: The user denied the login request

410.description: The device code expired, was already consumed, or is unknown

428.description: Authorization still pending — keep polling at the given interval

get.summary: Resolve the space this API key is scoped to
get.description: Returns the single space the API key belongs to. Lets a client auto-resolve the space id from the key alone (no spaceId in the URL).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional unique key (max 255 chars). Replays return the original response and add header Idempotency-Replayed: true. Scoped per space; expires after 24h.

sshPublicKey.description: SSH public key written to /root/.ssh/authorized_keys at boot. Must start with ssh-ed25519, ssh-rsa, ecdsa-sha2-*, ssh-dss, or sk-*@openssh.com.

post.description: Cold-restarts the Cube: the hypervisor process is stopped and relaunched, so the Cube boots against the host's current kernel. This is how a Cube picks up a refreshed guest kernel after a platform image update — a `reboot` issued inside the Cube cannot do it, because the kernel is supplied externally by the host. Disk state is preserved; only the kernel changes. Cube must be `running` (a stopped Cube already picks up the latest kernel when started). Concurrent restarts of the same Cube are rejected with 409 rather than queued twice.

409.description: Cube is not running, or a restart is already in progress

put.description: Sets the port INSIDE the Cube that SSH is forwarded to — NOT the host port you connect to. The host port is allocated by Krova and is unchanged by this call. Pointing this at a port nothing is listening on inside the Cube will make SSH unreachable; the default is 22. The change is applied atomically (the old port mapping is replaced).

cubePort.description: The port inside the Cube that sshd listens on (default 22). This is the Cube side of the mapping, not the host port.

get.summary: Get a Cube's SSH connection info
get.description: Host (server public IPv4), host SSH port, login user, and any captured SSH host public keys. `hostKeys` is empty until Krova captures cube host keys — clients fall back to trust-on-first-use until then.

get.summary: List custom domains attached to a Cube

post.summary: Attach a custom domain to a Cube
post.description: Attaches a domain and optionally configures any per-domain proxy settings at the same time. Settings can also be changed later via PATCH.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional unique key (max 255 chars). Replays return the original response and add header Idempotency-Replayed: true. Scoped per space; expires after 24h.

domain.description: The hostname to attach, e.g. app.example.com

port.description: Cube port the domain proxies to.

securityHeadersMode.description: enforced = proxy sets platform security headers (HSTS, X-Frame-Options, …); app_managed = the app's own headers pass through. Default enforced.

responseHeaderTimeoutSecs.description: Seconds the app may take to send response headers (streaming unaffected). Default 60.

responseHeaderOverrides.description: Header rewrites: `set` adds/overwrites, `remove` deletes. Null clears all.

requestHeaderOverrides.description: Header rewrites: `set` adds/overwrites, `remove` deletes. Null clears all.

maxRequestBodyMb.description: Max request body size (MB). Null = unlimited (default).

corsConfig.description: Per-domain CORS policy, applied at the edge. Null (default) = CORS disabled and no Access-Control-* header is emitted anywhere. When set, the proxy answers OPTIONS preflight itself (204, the cube is never involved) and adds the headers to normal AND error responses, so a cross-origin request to a failing or sleeping cube is never CORS-masked.

allowedOrigins.description: Exact scheme://host[:port] origins (no path, query or trailing slash), or the single-element wildcard ["*"]. "*" and allowCredentials are mutually exclusive.

allowedMethods.description: Allowed methods. Omitted = GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, OPTIONS.

allowedHeaders.description: Allowed request headers. Omitted/empty = echo the preflight's Access-Control-Request-Headers.

exposedHeaders.description: Response headers exposed to JS. Omitted/empty = none.

allowCredentials.description: Send Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true. Rejected together with the "*" origin.

maxAgeSeconds.description: Preflight cache TTL. Default 600; 86400 is Chromium's hard cap.

originScheme.description: Scheme the edge speaks to the CUBE on the backend hop. http (default) = cleartext. https = the cube terminates TLS itself (a control panel holding its own certificate, or an app listening on HTTPS) and answers plain HTTP with a redirect, so it cannot be reached over cleartext at all. Visitors are on HTTPS either way. The dial port is derived: https on the default port 80 connects on 443; a deliberate custom port is honoured exactly. Verified against the cube before it is applied — if the domain does not serve, the route is left on http.

responseCompression.description: Edge gzip/zstd compression. Default false (domains behind a CDN are already compressed there).

ipAllowList.description: Visitor IP/CIDR allow-list (v4+v6). Non-empty ⇒ only these reach the app. Null/empty = open.

basicAuthUser.description: HTTP Basic Auth username. Null/empty clears Basic Auth. Setting it requires basicAuthPassword.

basicAuthPassword.description: Plaintext Basic Auth password — bcrypt-hashed server-side, never stored or returned. Required when setting basicAuthUser.

patch.summary: Update a custom domain's proxy settings
